item.title: Good Bait Respect 190F
item.excerpt:
The Respect 190F is a slim-profile floating minnow designed for series saltwater anglers targeting powerful predators.

Despite its compact 190mm body, it is engineered to handle heavy-duty tackle setups up to PE8 while maintaining a tight and responsive swimming action.

Built with a reinforced 1.8mm trough-wire construction and capable of supporting #3/0 treble hooks, the Respect 190F is made to confidently fight large pelagic species in demanding conditions.

Its tight rolling action and stable swimming performance make it highly effective during slow retrieves, especially around rocky shorelines, reef structures and surface feeding zones.

Built for anglers chasing unforgettable fish in wild saltwater environments.

  • Length 190 mm

  • Gr. 73

prevItem.title: Good Bait BND 180F
prevItem.excerpt:
The Good Bait BnD was developed with one goal in mind: allowing anglers to perform several lure presentations with a single lure. Its innovative design enables diving pencil action, bubble-producing popper effects and subsurface minnow swimming action without changing tackle.

  • Diving jerk action with wobbling dive movement.

  • Short jerks creating strong bubble attraction.

  • Long jerks producing a straight slalom action.

  • Slow retrieve imitating a fleeing baitfish.

This versatility allows anglers to combine attraction, pursuit and feeding triggers during the same cast, making it highly effective on pressured or selective predators.

  • Length 180 mm

  • Gr. 91

  • Color YellowHead

nextItem.title: Good Bait FZR 188F
nextItem.excerpt:
FZR is not same as other top water stick baits

FZR is not rear balanced top water stick bait.

It is flat balanced. Not same as other popular stick baits.

This is most unique point and that is why it was born.

You can make small splash and diving action if you jerk on the top water.

Also you can keep swim under water if you keep jerk before float up.

It is all up to you.

Basically we designed it based on #4/0 treble hooks. But you can use #3/0 depends on situation. You can use single hooks, single hooks can make more wide zig-zag action.

  • Length 188 mm

  • Gr. 92
